items.topic: Jaffe-Campanacci versus fibrous dysplasia syndromes and Maffucci syndrome
items.destination_intent: Tumor 2026 — 3b4097df-8115-81aa-9357-d1e517c3108a; canonical syndrome comparison section upon explicit logging
items.teaching_point_placement: Beside the stem discriminator of NOF plus cafe-au-lait macules and mandibular giant cell lesion; compare classic Jaffe-Lichtenstein, McCune-Albright, Mazabraud, and Maffucci definitions
items.caption_intent: Exact supplied question slide with distal tibial metaphyseal lobulated lytic lesion identified in the supplied explanation as NOF. NOF plus cafe-au-lait macules and mandibular lesion favors classic Jaffe-Campanacci. Distinguish the NOF from fibrous dysplasia and enchondromas; preserve complete source image and explanation. Glasses alone are nonspecific. Modern NF1 overlap and FD/MAS spectrum should be distinguished from traditional exam eponyms.
